asa.multiplayer.screen.title: MultiPlayerScreen
asa.config.all.comment.creeperWarner-Ran: Creeper alarm range (centered on the player)
asa.config.all.comment.disableSubtitle: Disable subtitles when opening the material list in Litematica
asa.config.all.comment.disableConnection: This option can prevent connection timeouts when Litematica loads a schematic
asa.config.all.comment.disableLevelLoadi: Disables the terrain loading screen when enabled. Theoretically, this can slightly improve the speed of joining a world (same for servers)
asa.config.all.comment.disablePlayerArmo:
Disables player armor rendering when enabled
Finally, you can see the skin underneath!
asa.config.all.comment.tabFilter: Filter useless players and persistent fake players from the TAB menu
asa.config.all.comment.openFakeFetchGui: Open the fake player item retrieval menu
asa.config.all.comment.middleClickLitema:
After enabling, middle-clicking a block in a schematic that is not in the player's inventory will immediately retrieve it (requires LMS Carpet Addition)
Shift + middle-click retrieves 1 shulker box
Middle-click retrieves 1 stack
asa.config.all.comment.autoOpenFakeInv: Automatically open the fake player's inventory
asa.config.all.comment.fakeKillAuraRange: Fake player kill aura range (centered on the player)
asa.config.all.comment.enableFakeKillAur: Enable fake player kill aura blacklist
asa.config.all.comment.fakeKillAuraBlack: Fake player kill aura blacklist (only applies to players in the list, exact match, case-insensitive)
asa.config.all.comment.enableKillAuraWhi: Enable fake player kill aura whitelist
asa.config.all.comment.killAuraWhiteList: Fake player kill aura whitelist (only applies to players in the list, exact match, case-insensitive)
asa.config.all.comment.lowHealthAutoSend: Execute a customizable command; automatically send a chat message when the command is unavailable
asa.config.all.comment.canAlwaysDisconne: Adds a disconnect button to ReconfigScreen and ConnectScreen, allowing you to disconnect at any time
asa.config.all.comment.commandPm:
Supports batch operations on fake players
/pm <prefix> <start value> <end value> <Action>
/pm <start value> <end value> <Action>
asa.config.all.comment.commandPmExecutio: Wait time after each action, in ms
asa.config.all.comment.enableInventoryCl: Automatically clean up junk items when enabled
asa.config.all.comment.inventoryCleaner-: Save player inventory items to the blacklist/whitelist
asa.config.all.comment.canOpenMutilPlaye: Allow opening the multiplayer menu while in-game
asa.config.all.comment.enableCustomBlock: Allows customizing block collision boxes when enabled
Enable custom block collision box whitelist
Allows customizing block interaction collision boxes when enabled
Enable custom block interaction collision box whitelist
asa.config.all.comment.customBlockBlockI: Custom block interaction collision box whitelist
asa.config.all.comment.enableCustomBlock: Enable custom block interaction collision box blacklist
asa.config.all.comment.customBlockBlockI: Custom block interaction collision box blacklist
asa.config.all.comment.enableCustomLitem: Enable custom block collision box whitelist
asa.config.all.comment.customLitematicaB:
Custom schematic block replacement list
Format:
minecraft:item|minecraft:item1
asa.config.all.comment.enableAutoBlockRe: Enable automatic shulker box restocking (requires Tweakeroo automatic restocking)
Enable automatic shulker box restocking whitelist
Enable automatic shulker box restocking blacklist
asa.config.all.comment.disablePacketKick:
Prevents players from being kicked from the server due to packet errors when enabled
Recommended to use with ViaFabricPlus
Allows the client to forcibly join a server while ignoring packets that do not exist or are not registered on the client
asa.config.all.comment.disableNetworkPro: Prevents players from being kicked from the server due to network protocol errors
asa.config.all.comment.disableProfiler: Improves frame rate when disabled, but makes the pie chart unavailable
asa.config.all.comment.commandAutoVault:
Automatically execute the vault command
Usage:
/autovault player <prefix> <start value> <end value> <block X> <block Y> <block Z> <DIR> <In>
Equivalent to:
/player _AntiDeath_ spawn at <block X> <block Y> <block Z> facing <dir> <in>
/autovault set <vault XYZ>
asa.config.all.comment.trigger-boxItemSp:
After pressing the specified hotkey, save the item in the player's main hand and enable the shulker box item splitter
Automatically opens all shulker boxes in the player's inventory (excluding the hotbar) and drops matching items
asa.config.all.comment.fakeInvCache: Caches items in fake player inventories when enabled; schematic block retrieval prioritizes cached fake player inventories
asa.config.all.comment.MaterialList-Cacu: When enabled, the Litematica material list counts all items
When enabled, the Litematica material list counts items in cached fake player inventories
asa.config.all.comment.optItemFrame:
When enabled, significantly improves average FPS and 1% low FPS when facing many item frames or map art
⚠⚠⚠ WARNING ⚠⚠⚠
Due to major rendering code changes between Mojang versions (in plain English, I am too lazy to adapt it)
Full performance can only be guaranteed on 1.21.11+
Test data:
Minecraft 26.2 Tuning Pack 572 map art
Optimization disabled - Average FPS: 370~ FPS, 1% low: 80~ FPS
Optimization enabled - Average FPS: 900~ FPS, 1% low: 430~ FPS
asa.config.all.comment.optItemFrame-Fram: Modify the visibility of the item frame border
asa.config.all.comment.optSignText: Improve sign rendering performance by optimizing the hasMessage() method
asa.config.all.comment.optItemModel: Use Identifier to store item model information to reduce Map lookup overhead
asa.config.all.comment.optDirection: Optimize the Direction#byName method to improve performance
asa.config.all.comment.forceUseFireWork: Force the use of fireworks when enabled
asa.config.all.comment.useSignRunCommand: When each line of a sign starts with /, sneak-right-clicking the sign will automatically execute the command
